government.en: Stones from Aztec temples were used to construct churches and palaces and government buildings.
government.zh: 阿兹特克神庙的石头被用来建造教堂、宫殿和政府大楼。

government.en: The government has generally defended these policies by arguing that Singapore needs its stability.
government.zh: 政府通常通过辩称新加坡需要稳定性来为这些政策辩护。

government.en: The government was criticized for their plans to change certain benefits for old people.
government.zh: 政府因改变老年人某些福利的计划而受到批评。

government.en: The national security advisor would request funding from the government for a security emergency.
government.zh: 国家安全顾问会以应对安全紧急情况为由向政府申请资金。

government.en: The North Korean government said he was being treated well and receiving medical care.
government.zh: 朝鲜政府说他受到了良好的对待，也得到了医疗照顾。

goal.en: I’d also recommend that you try setting both personal and professional or academic goals.
goal.zh: 我也建议你尝试同时设定个人目标以及职业或学业目标。

goal.en: And finally, small wins are minor successes which contribute to a larger life goal.
goal.zh: 最后，“small wins”是微小的成功，它们有助于实现更大的生活目标。

goal.en: A goal like giving a presentation or writing a report or passing an exam.
goal.zh: 比如做演讲、写报告或通过考试这样的目标。

goal.en: But do proficiency tests actually help you in your goal to become fluent in English?
goal.zh: 但英语熟练度测试真的能帮你实现流利说英语的目标吗？

goal.en: So I don't know if necessarily, for some people, pure happiness is the ultimate goal.
goal.zh: 所以我不知道，对某些人来说，纯粹的幸福是否是最终目标。

gorilla.en: I remember myself going to see lowland gorillas at Zoo Atlanta every single year, and the point of this was to introduce us to conservation.
gorilla.zh: 我记得自己每年都去亚特兰大动物园看低地大猩猩，这样做的目的就是为了让我们了解自然保护。

goat.en: So has feeding kids cow milk or goat milk when breast milk runs out or is not available.
goat.zh: 给孩子喂牛奶或羊奶也是，当母乳用完或无法获得时。

goat.en: He still plays with them, and with the Mountain Goats too.
goat.zh: 他现在仍然和他们一起演奏，也和The Mountain Goats一起演奏。

goat.en: When we began to domesticate sheep, goats, and cattle, dogs made this possible on a much larger scale.
goat.zh: 当我们开始驯化绵羊、山羊和牛时，狗让这一切在更大规模上成为了可能。

goat.en: To graze means to eat grass and other wild plants, and grazers are the animals, including horses, cows and goats, which do this.
goat.zh: graze 意思是吃草和其他野生植物，grazers 则是指做这件事的动物，包括马、牛和山羊。

gossip.en: She feels people gossip about her posts and photos, using expressions like, ' Oh my gosh!
gossip.zh: 她觉得人们对她的帖子和照片八卦，使用诸如“天哪！”

gossip.en: For nearly a decade he kept a detailed personal diary that recorded everything he ate, drank, gossiped about, and went to see.
gossip.zh: 近十年来，他坚持写详细的个人日记，记录了他吃过的每一顿饭、喝过的每一杯酒、听到过的每一桩八卦以及看过的每一场演出。

gossip.en: To quote one book about Yale from 1871, “the mystery now attending its existence forms the one great enigma which college gossip never tires of discussing."
gossip.zh: 引用1871年关于耶鲁大学的一本书的话，“现在围绕其存在的神秘感构成了大学八卦永远讨论不腻的谜团。”

govern.en: It would govern them as part of its overseas empire for nearly ninety years.
govern.zh: 作为其海外帝国的一部分，法国管辖了这些岛屿近九十年。

govern.en: And we should also talk about FIFA, the international organization that governs football.
govern.zh: 我们还应该谈谈国际足联（FIFA），这个管理足球运动的国际组织。

govern.en: It argued that governments derive their powers from the consent of the governed.
govern.zh: 它认为政府的权力源于被统治者的同意。

govern.en: It questioned why an island, Britain, thousands of miles away, should govern an entire continent.
govern.zh: 它质疑为什么一个远在数千英里之外的岛屿——英国，应该统治整整一个大陆。

govern.en: Instead of being directly governed or directly ruled from Britain, they wanted self-rule.
govern.zh: 他们不再希望直接受到英国的治理或统治，而是想要自治。

gown.en: He wandered the corridors at night, white-bearded and gaunt in his dressing gown, talking to people who had been dead for decades.
gown.zh: 他穿着晨衣，顶着白胡子，面容憔悴，在夜间的走廊里徘徊，与那些已经死去几十年的人说话。

gown.en: It bore little resemblance to any modern university: no sprawling campus, no central library, no stone quadrangles where students wandered around in gowns.
gown.zh: 它与任何现代大学几乎毫无相似之处：没有错落有致的校园、没有中央图书馆、也没有穿着长袍的学生闲逛的石头方庭。

governor.en: This is always a formality. The governor general acts according to the advice of Canada’s elected government.
governor.zh: 这通常只是一种例行程序。总督会根据加拿大民选政府的建议行事。

governor.en: The word comes from Elbridge Gerry, a governor of Massachusetts in the US in the early 1800s.
governor.zh: 这个词来源于Elbridge Gerry，他是19世纪初美国马萨诸塞州的一位州长。

governor.en: In 1993, she helped the governor make Michigan one of the first states in the nation to allow charter schools.
governor.zh: 1993年，她协助州长使密歇根州成为全国最早允许设立特许学校的州之一。

governor.en: This time, the Texas Governor Greg Abbott threatened to arrest legislators and politicians who tried to block the process.
governor.zh: 这一次，得州州长Greg Abbott威胁要逮捕那些试图阻挠这一进程的议员和政治人物。

governor.en: He was not replacing Irish kings with English governors.
governor.zh: 他也没有用英国总督取代爱尔兰国王。

golden.en: But I genuinely think that if you remind yourself, these are the golden years.
golden.zh: 但我真心认为，如果你提醒自己，这就是黄金岁月。

golden.en: Like this right now, when you look back, these will be the golden years, right?
golden.zh: 就像现在，当你回首往事时，这些就是黄金岁月，对吧？

golden.en: The internal golden rule says, treat yourself like others should have treated you.
golden.zh: 而内在黄金法则说的是，对待自己要像别人本来应该对待你那样。

golden.en: He seemed to embody a golden future, a new chapter for Rome.
golden.zh: 他似乎体现了一个金色的未来，罗马的新篇章。

golden.en: And by the late 15th century, the golden age of the condottieri was coming to an end.
golden.zh: 到15世纪末，condottieri 的黄金时代走向了尾声。

golf.en: Before they ever become great, they’ve hit thousands and thousands of golf balls.
golf.zh: 在他们变得伟大之前，他们已经击打了成千上万个高尔夫球。

golf.en: But here’s the crucial part: when you practice skills like golf or darts, you get immediate feedback.
golf.zh: 但最关键的部分来了：当你练习高尔夫或飞镖之类的技能时，你会得到即时反馈。

golf.en: You know, like when you're playing golf, if you start thinking about it instead of just being in it, you can't do it anymore.
golf.zh: 你知道，就像打高尔夫球时，如果你开始思考它，而不是沉浸其中，你就再也打不好了。

golf.en: A degree in “golf management” might sound perfect for a 17-year-old fan of golf, but the reality is that it probably isn’t even the best course to study if they want to work in the golf industry.
golf.zh: 一个“高尔夫管理”学位对一个 17 岁的高尔夫迷来说听起来很完美，但现实是，如果他们想在高尔夫行业工作，它可能甚至不是最好的学习课程。

golf.en: A degree in “golf management” might sound perfect for a 17-year-old fan of golf, but the reality is that it probably isn’t even the best course to study if they want to work in the golf industry.
golf.zh: 一个“高尔夫管理”学位对一个 17 岁的高尔夫迷来说听起来很完美，但现实是，如果他们想在高尔夫行业工作，它可能甚至不是最好的学习课程。

goddess.en: He saw an asteroid that he named 16 Psyche, after the Greek goddess of the soul.
goddess.zh: 他发现了一颗小行星，并以希腊神话中灵魂女神的名字将其命名为 16 Psyche（灵神星）。

goddess.en: He appeared in public dressed as Apollo, Mercury, even Venus, the female goddess of love.
goddess.zh: 他在公众场合打扮成 Apollo、Mercury 甚至爱之女神 Venus。

goddess.en: He also claimed that his inspiration came directly from his family’s goddess Namagiri, who revealed the formulas to him in dreams.
goddess.zh: 他还声称自己的灵感直接来自于他家族的女神纳玛吉里（Namagiri），女神在梦中向他显现了这些公式。

goods.en: Spices appear in traditional British recipes for meat, desserts, sauces, baked goods, and drinks.
goods.zh: 香料出现在传统的英国肉类、甜点、酱汁、烘焙食品和饮料的食谱中。

goods.en: Today, we think of roads or railways as the main ways to transport people and goods.
goods.zh: 今天，我们认为公路或铁路是运输人员和货物的主要方式。

goods.en: Every day, billions of dollars of goods and services cross the border.
goods.zh: 每天都有价值数十亿美元的商品和服务跨越边境。

goods.en: They worked with many indigenous nations, swapping European goods for furs.
goods.zh: 他们与许多原住民民族合作，用欧洲的商品换取毛皮。

goods.en: This is the economic area that allows free movement of goods, services, people, capital across the continent.
goods.zh: 这是一个经济区域，允许货物、服务、人员和资本在整个欧洲大陆自由流动。

goodness.en: So the next morning after you rejected the 3,000 dollars, you’re going to wake up and say, “My goodness, I really must love this company if I rejected this amount.” Translation: We like suffering for things we love; we like it so much, that if we suffer for something, we will actually decide we must love it.
goodness.zh: 所以，在你拒绝了3,000美元的第二天早上，你会醒来说：“天哪，既然我拒绝了这么多钱，那我一定真的很爱这家公司。”翻译过来就是：我们喜欢为我们所爱的事物受苦；我们如此热爱，以至于如果我们为某事受苦，我们实际上会认为自己一定深爱着它。
